cards.name: Щит и молот
cards.scene: Два идола у ворот держат щит и молот. Край щита светится бирюзовым, навершие молота — янтарным.

cards.name: Перекличка ветров
cards.scene: Светлый порыв от дорожного идола пересекает мост. Вторая статуя подхватывает его, и струя становится лиловой.

cards.name: Сглаз и удар
cards.scene: Лиловый знак в форме глаза раскрывается над плитой. Следом по ней проходит красный удар, и камень трескается.

cards.name: Подношение
cards.scene: Один идол выставил на ступень чашу с янтарным даром. От второго идола тянется дуга, укрывающая чашу.

prompt:
Create ONE 1024×1024 square illustration atlas with a rigid, exact 2-column × 2-row layout. Four 512×512 squares isolated by a thin nearly black cross precisely at x=512 and y=512. Fantasy pixel illustrations for one priest's card set. The attached atlas is reference for rendering and idol design only. Match its clear pixel clusters, textured old gray stone, carved robes, weathered parchment and luminous magic. Each new scene must have a clean recognizable primary silhouette; keep narrative props and joins inside the central 65% vertically and 85% horizontally, since the card crop trims top and bottom. Ground all statues and physical objects with contact shadows. Use one continuous affect line only where requested, coherent perspective, discreet magic. Varied light and palettes. No lettering, UI, words, or watermark. Exact panel order.
Top left: two weathered standing stone idols on separate low bases in a sunny limestone courtyard. The first grips one broad shield of visibly solid turquoise stone in front of its torso. The second grips one short vertical carved hammer with a distinct horizontal squared amber-lit head, one visibly continuous handle held just below the head. Low eye level, props separated against pale masonry, quiet sage and copper.
Top right: broad side-on view of a small arch bridge across a misty gorge, two simple stone wayfinding idols on separate ends of the bridge. One ivory wind ribbon crosses the bridge left to right in a continuous S-curve, and becomes dark violet as it curls past the second idol. Pale turquoise morning and a clean blue backdrop. No extra ribbons.
Bottom left: in a mossy shrine alcove a tilted stone slab rests securely on a low plinth. A small violet eye-shaped hex shines directly above the slab, a single short diagonal vermilion impact streak ends in a fresh crack on the slab under it. A pair of small less contrasted idol niches flanks the alcove. Dark cobalt shade, crimson flash, no figure or weapons.
Bottom right: simple close three-quarter view of one stone offering basin on a broad temple step, containing one clearly recognizable glowing amber fruit. Two different small weathered stone idols stand behind it at different depths; a single thin jade protective arc from the second curves over the bowl. Full rim and base of the bowl in view. Late spring sun, jade shade, cream and honey color.

cards.name: Свита
cards.scene: У двух больших идолов из световых кругов выходят маленькие каменные спутники.

cards.name: Двойной оберег
cards.scene: Перед одной статуей два световых щита встали один за другим.

cards.name: Щедрый дар
cards.scene: На распущенном свитке стоят две отдельные чаши. В каждой горит золотой бутон.
